description: Sequencer built on a binary counter, mixing the counter's bits together in whatever proportions the knobs set to make a repeating control voltage

params.text: How much that bit of the counter adds to the output voltage, from -10 to +10, so a bit can pull the voltage down as well as push it up
Sets the largest voltage the mix can reach, 2V, 5V or 10V, divided equally across the six division knobs
Rate of the internal clock, doubling per volt of knob travel from 0.125Hz at one end to 128Hz at the other
Slews the output voltage so that it glides between steps rather than jumping
Shapes the glide, linear at one end and logarithmic at the other

inputs.text: A clock patched here advances the counter and replaces the internal clock
A rising edge sets the counter back to zero; with nothing patched here the counter is instead reset by the rising edge of the RUN input
A high gate lets the sequencer run and a low gate stops it, holding the output at 0V; with nothing patched the sequencer runs
A voltage sampled at each rising clock edge, used in place of the SCALE switch as the total the division knobs share, each knob at full reaching a sixth of it

outputs.text: The mixed division knobs as a voltage, after the LAG and SHAPE controls have worked on it
The mixed output voltage with its sign flipped
Carries the internal clock, or the signal at the EXT. CLOCK input when one is patched
A 1ms trigger for every clock pulse

menu: Initialize Division Mix Only — puts the six division knobs back to their default positions and leaves the rest of the module as it is
Randomize Division Mix Only — sets the six division knobs to random positions and leaves the rest of the module as it is
Add CV expander — places a Sequencer CV Expander to the right of this module
Add output expander — places a Sequencer Output Expander to the right of this module
Add trigger expander — places a Sequencer Trigger Expander to the right of this module
Add random melody expander — places a Gated Comparator Random Melody expander to the right of this module
Add logic expander — places a Gated Comparator Gate Logic expander to the right of this module
